text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
While training with Rice Shower on the<n>ramped
track...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
We notice Mihono Bourbon silently<n>running along
the same course.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her speed and strength are<n>incredible, just like
when she's in a<n>real race.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Warm-up complete. Checking vital<n>signs... No
abnormalities detected.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
W-wow... She barely broke a sweat<n>even after
running like that...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower might be able to learn<n>something from
Mihono Bourbon's<n>running style.
choice_data_list: How about we go ask about her training regimen?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh? A-are we allowed to do that?
choice_data_list: Sure, think of it as another part of training.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...R-right. I do want to run like that,after all.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower collects herself and goes<n>to speak to
Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-you were incredible back there... Do<n>you always
run like that?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
That was merely a warm-up. Today's<n>primary
training begins now.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A w-warm-up?! You were just getting<n>started?!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Commencing weighted ramp training<n>preparation.
Attaching weights to<n>designated areas...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mihono Bourbon suddenly begins<n>attaching
massive weight to her<n>ankles!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You're going to run the ramped track<n>with
weights?! Aren't they heavy?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: They are.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah... I-I suppose that was<n>obvious...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
However, according to my<n>calculations, this amount
of resistance<n>is necessary for the most effective
training.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
If you would like, you may use the<n>weights over
there.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Returning to primary objective.<n>Confirming course
conditions...<n>Conditions favorable. Commencing<n>final
weight adjustments.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She adds a few more weights before<n>taking off.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: W-wow! She's going just as fast as<n>before!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: O-okay... Maybe I should try it too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: But it looks way too heavy...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: What should I do?
choice_data_list: Challenge yourself as best you can!

Why not just observe Mihono Bourbon some
more?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: What should I do?
choice_data_list: Challenge yourself as best you can!

Why not just observe Mihono Bourbon some
more?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-you're right! I'm going to challenge<n>myself!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Maybe I'll just try one... to start.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: She tries to pick up one of the<n>weights...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-it's heavier than I thought!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-but... I am challenging myself, after<n>all!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She puts on the heaviest weights she<n>can still run
with and takes on the<n>ramped track.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It looks as exhausting as one would<n>expect, but it
seems like her hard<n>work is going to pay off.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Y-you're right. Maybe she has some<n>kind of secret
technique.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Watch and learn... Watch and learn... I<n>must watch
Mihono Bourbon and<n>learn all that I can.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Stare...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She observes Mihono Bourbon's<n>vigorous run
intently.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Aha! M-maybe...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It looks like she's learned something<n>from
observing Mihono Bourbon's<n>practice up close.
